name: Hatchling
summary: Hold a speckled egg until it bursts open in a shower of shell and a baby dragon pops out
about: A speckled egg sits in a twig nest. Hold it and glowing motes spiral in while a ring fills, the egg squashes, rocks harder and cracks spread, until it bursts: shell pieces fly and bounce, sparks shoot out, the screen shakes and a tiny dragon pops up under a spinning sunburst. Good for a playful landing page, a game site or a surprise reveal.
how: Press and hold the egg with a mouse or finger, or focus it and hold Space or Enter.
The ring fills, motes stream into the egg and glowing cracks spread; let go and it slowly settles back.
When the ring is full the shell bursts apart and a dragon with a random name pops up; its eyes follow your pointer.
Tickle it to make it giggle and puff a fire bubble with embers, or lay a new egg in a new colour.
With reduced motion there are no particles or shakes, and the dragon fades in instead of jumping.
